Physiotherapy is complex speciality, as it deals with all the disciplines of medicine, eg. Muscular -skeletal, Cardio-thoracic, Neurological, Paediatric , Community Based Rehabilitation, Obstetrics and Gynaecology, Sports Medicine Seats: 60 Duration: 8 Semester + 6 Month Internship Eligibility: 10+2 or equivalent in Science Group (PCB) Career Aspects: Working as an independent Physiotherapist and set up his/her own clinic, can do private practices. Undertaking higher studies – Master of Physiotherapy. Seeking employment in Government Hospitals, Clinics, Nursing Homes and Private Hospitals. Providing access to Sports Institutions. Accepting teaching profession as a career in College of Physiotherapy. Scope of Higher Education: Masters in Physiotherapy (MPT) in specialised branches. Clinical Fellowship Programmes. Post- Doctoral Programmes. DPT- Doctor of Physiotherapy/ Physical Theory.
